## Changes
- Whisper: a short answer said twice ("Da." … "Da.") is no longer dropped from the transcript the second time. - Whisper: a call in a language you set up is no longer transcribed in another language because one loud stretch sounded like it (an accented English call read as Italian). - Reminders: action items sent to Reminders now follow Update with AI, its Undo and Regenerate, and they are removed when you delete the call, so you no longer get stale or duplicate reminders.

## Changes
- Live captions window: its settings moved to Settings → Transcription, right under Live captions, and Settings now warns you when live captions are off, since the window only appears while they run.

## Changes
- Recording: when the Mac or Ahoy is briefly busy during a call, your voice and the other side no longer drift apart for the rest of the recording, and the Audio issues chip no longer reports gaps that aren't there. - "Both": the copy of the call uploaded to Google for the review is now deleted as soon as the review ends, and a network blip during the upload no longer sends the whole call again. - Deleting a call while Ahoy re-exports your calls no longer brings its folder back.
